defect: Shell-based agent command runner could interpret compound commands
evidence: Source inspection found subprocess shell=True and substring blacklist
repair: Replaced with shell-free argv allowlist metacharacter rejection workspace containment and bounded timeout

defect: Approval labels were not enforced by the shared ToolGateway
evidence: Model path was guarded but direct gateway/API calls dispatched effectful handlers
repair: Centralized approval gate; explicit approved path used by human diff and build controls

defect: Diff apply or rollback could overwrite changes made after review
evidence: No source digest checked immediately before write
repair: Added original/new byte SHA-256 checks and atomic writes; stale operation returns STALE

defect: Chat composer stripped whitespace from prompt boundary
repair: Only use strip for empty-input detection and forward original composer text

defect: New user prompt was persisted but omitted from the current model turn
evidence: AgentRuntime loaded a Session then SessionManager.append_message reloaded a separate object; provider history used the stale snapshot
repair: Reload the updated session after append before constructing the sliding history; add exact multiline Unicode and large-payload serialization regressions

defect: Fixed first-50-line slice omitted the active objective and resume state
evidence: Current objective was in section G after line 100 but system prompt only included first 50 lines
repair: Select canonical identity constraints and active-state sections by heading with an explicit character cap

defect: Stop cleared busy state before worker completion so a new send could overwrite worker session/prompt fields
evidence: AgentService.stop set busy false immediately while the worker could still be inside provider streaming
repair: Keep service busy until worker done/error; prevent new dispatch; ignore late old-task UI events after creating a new session

defect: Optional backend server accepted external bind hosts and wildcard CORS
evidence: Launcher accepted --host 0.0.0.0 and app allowed every origin
repair: Removed CORS middleware and rejected non-loopback server hosts

defect: No standalone Windows executable can be built with current environment
evidence: PyInstaller is absent and no other approved packager is installed
repair: Package after approved packager is available; preserve model exclusion

defect: The earlier checkpoint could not reach the Ollama endpoint
evidence: Earlier default-sandbox requests were blocked; later socket-enabled checks listed the canonical model and completed direct API provider and AgentRuntime streams
repair: Verified gameforge-27b-sft:latest digest 03d36e692be8736b1897f3028f9ba0223ee99822cc864826df825fac2a7a013b through /api/tags and successful think=false generation plus provider/AgentRuntime streams
regression: Direct outputs GAMEFORGE_OK IDE_STREAM_OK and AGENT_RUNTIME_OK

defect: Step 13 documentation and AC-23 still marked the Windows desktop deferred despite later product-priority D-029
evidence: Full unit run failed at tests/unit/test_acceptance_criteria.py::test_ac_23_product_deferral; strategy table had stale deferral
repair: Updated strategy Step 13 status and acceptance criterion to follow later D-029; recorded D-037

defect: Backend launch banner used an emoji that raises UnicodeEncodeError under CP1252 and prevented --serve startup
evidence: python -m src.gameforge_ide.launcher --serve exited before Uvicorn with CP1252 UnicodeEncodeError
repair: Replaced the console banner with ASCII-safe text
regression: Real loopback server startup and health/context HTTP roundtrip; current full suite 195 passed

evidence: Source inspection confirmed no bearer-token validation
